channel.title: Pranav Dhawan — Blog
channel.description: Short lessons from Pranav Dhawan's AI and ML projects.

item.title: Why my AI assistant's memory stays on my machine
item.description: Assistants hide the context they pick and scatter your history. Singularity keeps memory local, cited to the exact source, behind a redaction gate.

item.title: Recall first: picking a PII model that runs on-device
item.description: Four transformers, 54 entity types, one held-out set. Why recall decided it, and how DeBERTa ended up running locally in under 100ms.

item.title: When the simple model wins
item.description: My thesis benchmarked 10+ models for stock forecasting. The surprise: a standalone LSTM stayed competitive with fused multimodal models.

item.title: Why I split my legal RAG into two models
item.description: About 3 in 10 generated outputs invented realistic-looking filing dates. Routing factual fields to extractive QA fixed it.
